audit_area: Audit D — Fencing Validation at the Final State-Mutation Boundary

fencing_attack_vector_tests.scenario: Worker sleeps past TTL window and attempts commit without competing reservation
fencing_attack_vector_tests.expected_behavior: Commit rejected; expired reservation cleared from state

fencing_attack_vector_tests.vector: Stale worker commit after generation advance (contended pre-emption)
fencing_attack_vector_tests.scenario: Worker A experiences 1.1s lag; Worker B acquires next generation slot; Worker A attempts commit
fencing_attack_vector_tests.expected_behavior: Worker A commit rejected due to token and generation mismatch; Worker B reservation preserved

fencing_attack_vector_tests.scenario: Worker commits valid token once, then immediately re-submits identical commit call
fencing_attack_vector_tests.expected_behavior: First commit succeeds; second commit rejected (reservation already cleared)

fencing_attack_vector_tests.scenario: Worker releases reservation after order failure, then rogue caller attempts to commit released token
Reservation persisted; broker crashes and restarts; valid commit attempted by active worker
fencing_attack_vector_tests.expected_behavior: Pending reservation token and generation recovered from disk; valid commit accepted within TTL
